verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a framework for building voice agents, so a natural-language operating interface is a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no way to operate Pipecat itself through natural-language commands. The context-hub MCP server (pipecat-docs-11) and the scaffolded AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files (pipecat-docs-16) only supply docs and context to an external coding agent. That makes them adjacent aids, and the conversational bots users build with Pipecat are developer-built output, not a way to operate the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
